description:
## Problem
`_execute_load_only_mode` (`benchbox/core/runner/runner.py:528-585`) calls `create_schema` and `load_data` directly and never calls `apply_unified_tuning`. Observed on DuckDB with a sort-only custom config:
- the DataLoader CTAS sort and index re-create still ran (`idx_lineitem_sort` and `idx_orders_sort` present);
- constraints, pre-load DDL, dropped-intent accounting and platform optimizations were skipped;
- no metadata was saved;
- the bundle had `tuning_mode: custom` with `platform.tuning: null`.

## Options
- **(A) Recommended.** Full lifecycle parity with a full run: apply, reconcile, metadata, ledger, receipt and `platform.tuning` export.
- **(B)** Refuse any `--tuning` other than `notuning` combined with load-only phases, with an actionable error.

## Guardrails
- A load-only bundle must never carry a tuned `tuning_mode` without a `platform.tuning` section.

## Gate protocol
- This is a decision record, not an implementation.
- Implementation items that list this gate in `needs` must not start until it is done.
- The decision owner is the maintainer.
- Record the outcome as a dated ADR addendum (addenda only; do not rewrite recorded decisions) and paste the decision into this item's context before finishing.
